scope: Broaden the ACIS/SAB reader and semantic-evidence route inventory; assess whether cadmpeg v0.6.1 can improve an existing composed external checkpoint without changing the local fast implementation loop or promoting support claims.

method.kind: Primary-source release, API, support-ladder, and route documentation review with local-plan reconciliation
localInspection: DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md: existing Slice8/PAR-06/PAR-07, S5/S8, cq-acis, HOOPS, Ansys, and FreeCAD gates
DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md: findings/subplan totals and deferred external J statuses
method.limitations: Project documentation and release assets are capability disclosures, not execution or conformance results. The cadmpeg source lineage was not audited, its published artifact was not downloaded or run, and no source DWG-to-AcDs-to-payload join or B-rep geometry was independently measured in this review.

evidence.topic: cadmpeg v0.6.1 release identity and availability
evidence.observed: The official release page identifies tag v0.6.1 at commit 9e8f6d6, released 2026-10-10, with checksummed prebuilt assets for Apple Silicon and Intel macOS, x64 Windows, and x64/ARM64 Linux. The project declares Apache-2.0 code and CC-BY-4.0 format documentation.
doesNotEstablish: the binary was downloaded, signature-checked, or executed
parser independence by source-code lineage audit
runtime acceptance or semantic correctness for any SAT/SAB profile
permission to redistribute any input drawing
evidence.planUse: Admit only as an optional exact-version candidate at the already-planned composed checkpoint. Pin tag, commit, platform asset, SHA-256, runtime, command, and report; do not add a dependency, CI lane, or per-slice invocation.

evidence.topic: bare SAT/SAB decoder scope and maturity
evidence.observed: The v0.6.1 cadmpeg-codec-sat documentation describes a read-only decoder for bare SAT/SMT/SAB/SMB streams, with separate ASM BinaryFile4/8, text SAT/SMT, and Spatial ACIS 217/218 binary branches. It is not an outer DWG/DXF/AcDs container reader. The project scores the ACIS/ASM bare-stream format L1 (opened/profiled); its own ladder requires typed geometry/units at L2 and connected validated topology at L3. Unsupported records can remain raw, and geometry transfer may be blocked with an explicit loss.
doesNotEstablish: full mainstream ACIS geometry coverage despite the read API
B-rep validity from record framing or reference closure
DWG AcDs owner/index association or source-entity identity
evidence.planUse: Use only as a bounded second parser/typed-record inventory. Require exact payload hash/profile, complete body/reference disposition, units/tolerances, and loss report; `geometry_transferred=false`, unsupported shape-relevant records, or an unadmitted dialect makes the cell NOT_QUALIFIED.

evidence.observed: cq-acis supplies an experimental payload-to-CadQuery/OCCT shape path that shares OCCT kernel lineage with FreeCAD. Ansys v261 documents a licensed standalone SAT/SAB reader through ACIS 2023 on Windows/Linux for solids, surfaces, and lines; it does not preserve CAD associativity/parameters and skips hidden/suppressed parts. HOOPS documents an optional SAT/SAB B-rep/physical-property route and remains the selected macOS ARM64 candidate. FreeCAD's documented DWG route converts through an external converter to DXF and does not thereby establish stock ACIS import.
doesNotEstablish: a license or installed runtime is available for HOOPS or Ansys
any candidate accepts a particular payload or carries its units correctly
any payload reader validates the outer DWG AcDs graph
cq-acis and FreeCAD provide independent kernel results
evidence.planUse: Keep parser, kernel, outer DWG graph, native application, platform, and operation as separate evidence lanes. Pair cadmpeg only with an already-authorized geometry route after exact-profile preflight; preserve native FreeCAD Linux and Windows gates independently.

readinessRefinement: add cadmpeg v0.6.1 as a candidate bare SAT/SAB parser cross-check, not as a geometry kernel or outer DWG/DXF/AcDs reader
preflight pinned release asset and exact input profile once at the existing composed checkpoint; no per-slice external execution
require independent source-entity/owner/payload association for any AcDs claim and an eligible separate geometry route for B-rep semantics
retain unsupported records, losses, units, hidden-body behavior, and geometry-transfer status as explicit evidence fields
leave all six external J items DEFERRED_EXTERNAL until their existing independent qualification conditions are met
